candidates.angle: Arjuna names Krishna as the father, teacher, and unmatched power
candidates.evidence: पिता... गुरुर्गरीयान्... अप्रतिमप्रभाव (father... greatest teacher... unmatched power)

candidates.angle: the three worlds cannot equal you, much less surpass you
candidates.evidence: न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्योलोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव (no one equals you... much less surpasses you in the three worlds)

candidates.angle: Arjuna apologizes for familiarity before naming Krishna as the supreme source
candidates.evidence: After apologizing for his earlier familiarity, he now names Krishna as the source, teacher, and unmatched power behind all existence.

angle_en: Recognition of the highest power dissolves all comparison.

en.intro: Arjuna apologizes for his familiar ways, then names the supreme source behind all existence. Listen to how he defines the Lord.
en.notice: Arjuna names Krishna as the father, the greatest teacher, and the unmatched power. He states that in the three worlds, no one equals him, much less surpasses him.
en.next: Arjuna bows, seeking to please the Lord of praise, and asks for forgiveness as a father forgives a son.
en.meaning: You are the father of all moving and unmoving beings, the highest object of reverence, and the greatest teacher. In the three worlds, no one equals you, much less surpasses you.
en.angle_en: The father, greatest teacher, and unmatched power

hi.intro: अर्जुन अपनी परिचित बातों के लिए क्षमा माँगते हैं, फिर उस परम स्रोत का नाम लेते हैं जो सब कुछ है। सुनिए, वे भगवान को कैसे परिभाषित करते हैं।
hi.meaning: पिता... गुरुर्गरीयान्... अप्रतिमप्रभाव (पिता... गुरुओंके महान् गुरु... अप्रतिम प्रभावशाली)
hi.notice: अर्जुन भगवान को पिता, गुरुोंके महान् गुरु, और अप्रतिम शक्ति के रूप में पुकारते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि तीनों लोकों में आपके बराबर कोई नहीं है, तो आपसे बड़ा होना तो दूर की बात है।
hi.next: अर्जुन साष्टांग प्रणाम करते हैं, भगवान की स्तुति करते हैं और एक पिता की तरह उनसे क्षमा माँगते हैं।
hi.angle_hi: पिता, गुरुोंके महान् गुरु, और अप्रतिम शक्ति

en.intro: Arjuna apologizes for his familiar ways, then names the supreme source behind all existence. Listen to how he defines the Lord.
en.body: You are the father of all moving and unmoving beings, the highest object of reverence, and the greatest teacher. In the three worlds, no one equals you, much less surpasses you. Arjuna names Krishna as the father, the greatest teacher, and the unmatched power. He states that in the three worlds, no one equals him, much less surpasses him. Arjuna bows, seeking to please the Lord of praise, and asks for forgiveness as a father forgives a son.

issues: wrong_fact: "Arjuna bows again, asking the Lord to forgive him as a father forgives a son." (The 'next' description in the English intro incorrectly states that Arjuna bows again and asks for forgiveness as a father forgives a son. The next verse (44) is about seeking forgiveness in general terms (like a father, friend, or lover), and the previous verse (42) is the one where Arjuna specifically apologizes and asks for forgiveness. The script misattributes the content of the previous verse to the 'next' notice.)
